summary: Wire PM TUI Approve & run to plate_pm_complete status=run: explicit promote proposed→delegated with fleet/loop dispatch, including under risk=off (#660/#889).
migration_impact: Agents/hosts that only called plate_pm_complete with status=done after manual work should use status=run for the Approve & run option. Pending high-impact checkpoints still block approve&run until decided.
migration_guidance: 2. For proposed PM rows: plate_pm_complete assignment_id status=run (or gh plate pm --complete ID --complete-status run).
4. High-impact: approve #648 checkpoint first, then status=run (or rely on promote_checkpoint_ready on next cycle).
agent_notes: status=run|approve|approve_run is the explicit consent path that overrides packet.auto_delegate=false under risk=off. Does not re-enable AutonomyEngine autopilot. Host TUI host_hint documents the call.
